sentences: The optical band gap of GaN measured by our absorption setup is 3420 meV.
Our exciton binding energy is 25 meV.
Our PBE calculation yielded a ZnO band gap of 0.75.
For comparison, CdO has an optical band gap of 2.2 eV.
We measured an optical band gap of 3.6 eV for rutile SnO2 at 300 K.
For the same phase our HSE calculation gives a band gap of 3.9 eV at 0 K.
The InP optical band gap varies between 1.30 and 1.42 eV.
Prior literature gives the exciton binding energy of InP as 0.005 eV.
Our absorption-derived CdTe band gap is 2.403264951e-19 J.
Prior work estimated the monolayer MoS2 exciton binding energy at 0.35 eV.
Our tunneling measurement yields a MoS2 electronic band gap of 2.24 ± 0.04 eV.
